text:
[LSIG.4.2] All v1 aggregations meet this bar and are bit-reproducible on any
IEEE-754 platform, in every mode:

- `active_fraction` — integer (int64-ns) accumulation via the running sum,
  one correctly-rounded divide.
- `onset_rate` — running-sum count divided by the window.
- `integral` — fixed-order `Float64` accumulation, including the `K = 128`
  recompute.
